intro: Nashville's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $126/month, down 0.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). StorageUnitCosts lists $127 (August 2026). Storage Stats puts the Nashville metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $110, down 10.2% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $147. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); Aug 2026 (StorageUnitCosts); Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $60 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $62 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$60.

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $81 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $83 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$89. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $126, down 0.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $127, down 1.6% from a year earlier (Aug 2026). Storage Stats Nashville metro non-climate asking rent $110, down 10.2% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Nashville alone. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$147.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $169 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$204.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $209 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $210 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$275.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Aldrich Heights (~$94), Elysian Park (~$107), Hillwood (~$114) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Edgefield (~$346) is among the highest.
Nashville has about 57 facilities and 7.0 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
